item.title: White House Not Considering SPR Release to Lower Oil Prices, Says Kevin Hassett
item.description: Kevin Hassett says the White House is not currently considering releasing oil from the Strategic Petroleum Reserve to lower prices.

item.title: New Report Reveals Deception Tactics Used Before Khamenei Strike
item.description: Trey Yingst reports new details about the strike that killed Ali Khamenei, saying a deception campaign was carried out to convince Iranian officials that the attack was not imminent. item.title: Footage Shows Destruction in Beirut’s Dahiyeh After Israeli Airstrikes
item.description: Footage from the Dahiyeh district in Beirut shows the aftermath and destruction following multiple Israeli airstrikes.

item.title: Israeli Strike Reportedly Hits UNIFIL Position in Southern Lebanon
item.description: Reports out of Lebanon say an Israeli strike targeted a position belonging to the UNIFIL in the town of Al-Qawzah in southern Lebanon.

item.title: Alleged Video Shows Iranian Missile Striking Prince Sultan Air Base in Saudi Arabia
item.description: Dramatic footage circulating online appears to show an Iranian ballistic missile slamming into the area of Prince Sultan Air Base in Al-Kharj, Saudi Arabia, with the video capturing the moment of impact as a massive explosion erupts near the base.

item.title: WH: Operation Epic Fury Expected to Achieve Objectives in 4–6 Weeks
item.description: WH Press Secretary Karoline Leavitt: What I will tell you is what President Trump has already laid out, which is that the achievable objectives of Operation Epic Fury we expect to last about 4-6 weeks, and we are well on our way to achieving those objectives.
